You need to prevent two agents from reserving the same item for overlapping dates, including when they save simultaneously.
I recommend keeping the spreadsheet but routing every reservation through one save process that checks availability and records the booking atomically, rejecting conflicts; direct reservation edits must be blocked.
Red highlighting can help agents spot problems, but colours and reminders alone do not meet your requirement, so I would not ship them as the fix.
